title: Crate Dock
author: ZadenZ
description: Warehouse sorting chaos: sort the crate stream into the right bins across 10 levels and an Endless mode, then bend your brain in Rack Jam, a sliding-rack puzzle mode with 12 levels and star ratings. Native 3DS port of the Save Point arcade game.
long_description:
Crate Dock is two games in one. In belt sorting, crates ride in from the right and you tap the touch-screen bin that matches the front crate's color - rainbow crates fit any bin. Fill a bin to ship it; a wrong bin or a crate rolling off the end costs a life. Clear the shipping quota across 10 LEVELS, or ride the ever-faster ENDLESS belt for a best score.

Rack Jam is the puzzle half: tap a rack, then tap where to move its top crates, and seal racks of 4 matching crates. 12 levels with star ratings (beat par for 3 stars) plus an endless mode with a move budget and 3 hearts.

Features:
- Progress, unlocks and best scores save to the SD card
- Physical controls mirror the touch screen (D-Pad plus A to sort)
- Synthesized effects and a belt-mode music loop

The .cia installs to the Home Menu; the .3dsx runs from the Homebrew Launcher, and both share one save file.
